option.name: Synth
option.description: Inspect and adjust the current synth patch

suboption.name: State
suboption.description: Show current synth patch, audio status, pressed notes, and recent MIDI events

suboption.name: Params
suboption.description: List safe synth parameters, ranges, units, and built-in presets

suboption.description: Set one synth parameter to a normalized value

suboption.name: Patch
suboption.description: Apply multiple normalized synth parameter values

suboption.description: Save the current synth patch as a user preset
